correctness.rationale: For every n≥3 and every positive rate vector, the cycle resolvent is an exactly summable finite geometric series, with diagonal (1−t_i)/(1−P). The theta-step is a positive scalar multiple of this resolvent minus a diagonal matrix, so the fastest-rate diagonal uniquely controls entrywise positivity. A strict log-derivative inequality from the positive cross-terms of ∏(1+a_j/t_j) proves single crossing from 1 to π_min without reversibility. The theta endpoints are direct. Strict concavity of log(sr/(1+sr)) and Karamata establish the rate-majorization law; stationarity and continuity settle uniform optimizer uniqueness, critical boundary and nonuniqueness above. Exact-rational standalone checker replayed with 1065 assertions groups, not offered as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The closest published method-class analysis (Horváth 1998/2005), cyclic centered-difference theta positivity (Hadjimichael–Ketcheson–Lóczi 2021), matrix Cayley identity (Fallat–Tsatsomeros 2002), and public resolvent-return Markov theorem (2026) do not, in their inspected material, imply the theorem for genuinely nonreversible one-way cycles with arbitrary heterogeneous rates and fixed-budget strict majorization. A general diagonal resolvent criterion is acknowledged as prior. The new logical steps are the cyclic-product return formula, fastest-site monotonicity, and global rate-allocation transition; an unindexed equivalent remains possible.
residual_risks: The general resolvent-diagonal criterion is known prior art; novelty must rest on the directed-cycle strict monotonicity and rate-majorization optimization, not that identity.
Specialized CTMC circulation, cyclic upwind discretization, and Schur-order theory may contain an equivalent theorem not indexed or retrieved.
Novelty assessment and proof review are not independent expert validation.

value.rationale: Fixed-generator theta-method positivity on irreversible cyclic transport is mathematically and numerically natural. The result decides the entire positive timestep set without matrix inversion, proves no reentrant positivity in a nonreversible class, and gives a sharp rate-budget design principle with strict majorization and a precise uniqueness/nonuniqueness transition at θ=(n−1)/n. The decision is exact for all positive real rates and infinitely many graph sizes, not an arbitrary finite example.
